saw_lines: Fashion buyers rarely browse a whole boutique. They come for one styled piece, a knit or a dress, and decide quickly.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line of the ad, when the shopper decides if the piece fits.
Your site offers up to 60% off, yet 0 of 11 ads mention a discount, so put the 30% off offer in the first line of three new ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 20 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers up to 60% off, yet 0 of 11 ads mention a discount, so a first-time buyer has no reason to act. Put the 30% off offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

5 of your 11 copy ads open on the same denim line, so the account leans on one opening. Write three new angles from your range, the fall dress, the knit and the tank, and run each against the denim opener.

Your site answers shipping questions, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a new buyer has to click through to find out. Open two new ads for first-time buyers with one shipping line before the product is named.

Your site shows prices from $30 to $120, yet 0 of 30 ads mention price, so a buyer weighing two pieces has nothing to compare. Lead one ad with the Amber Nights dress and its price, set beside the Gina jacket.

ads_1: Fall dress and knit openers tested against the denim hook, 30% off up front
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok, X and YouTube
